interface.title: EnvGeo Seawater — Interactive Platform for Exploring Seawater Isotope and Hydrographic Data (v1.3.5)
interface.field: Chemical oceanography / stable-isotope hydrology (seawater δ18O, δD, d-excess, temperature, salinity)
interface.stage_of_work: Data exploration, comparison with reference compilations, quality checking of new measurements, and making figures for publication
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter the bundled seawater isotope and hydrographic compilations (EnvGeo ECS–Japan Sea, Around Japan, Global) by region, transect, reference, time, depth and value ranges, then view them as T-S diagrams, depth profiles, salinity–δ18O regressions, maps and 3D/4D scatters, optionally with your own uploaded measurements and a check for duplicates across datasets.

data.note: Most work used the bundled EnvGeo [ECS–Japan Sea] dataset (2,222 rows) and EnvGeo + Around Japan (2,641 rows). example_upload_seawater.csv (13 rows) was uploaded on the User Data Check page, and its columns were detected automatically. The first data load took about 30 s. Online map tiles were unavailable, so maps fell back to, or were set to, the offline coastline. The EnvGeo + Global source and the spatial pages (Isotope Hydrographic Mapping, 3D 4D Visualizer, 2Dplus Visualizer, Vertical Section Visualizer, Custom Parameter Plot) were not explored, so this tree covers only the filtering, T-S, profile, regression, upload-check and duplicate-screen half of the tool.

tree.general: Explore seawater isotope and hydrographic data by region, compare it with reference datasets, check new measurements and export figures and data
tree.specific: Use the EnvGeo Seawater pages to filter the bundled EnvGeo / Around Japan data, build T-S diagrams, depth profiles and S–δ18O regressions, check an uploaded CSV and screen bundled datasets for duplicates
